content:
maria (eng-security): Heads up — several new hires hitting onboarding today lost access to the 'dedicated-admin' role immediately after being provisioned. They show up as assigned, then flip to 'viewer' within ~30s. Reports from Support + a couple of stack traces attached.

sam (identity): ugh. Any recent role-mapper changes?

maria (eng-security): We shipped role-mapper lambda change in last release (rollout 2024-10-08) that added deterministic sorting for attributes. deploy-bot says the deploy at 2024-10-08T18:03:19Z.

deploy-bot: Deployed role-mapper v2.13.0 by @devon — rollout 12/12 hosts.

devon (eng): I added attribute normalization to avoid case mismatches. Didn't touch the fallback logic.

neha (oncall): I pulled audit logs — I see repeated SetRole / RemoveRole for the same user with the same request_id: req_93b1... Looks like a loop. idaudit-bot output:
```
2024-10-11T18:21:03Z INFO role-service SetRole user=alice@acme.com role=dedicated-admin req=req_93b1
2024-10-11T18:21:04Z INFO role-service RemoveRole user=alice@acme.com role=dedicated-admin req=req_93b1
2024-10-11T18:21:05Z INFO role-service SetRole user=alice@acme.com role=viewer req=req_93b1
```

sam (identity): Same request_id ringing multiple actions is our strong indicator it's the role-mapper lambda re-emitting events while it retries. Could be caused by payload size or Unserializable attribute dropping.

maria (eng-security): One of the repros attached a SAML assertion that looks truncated — RelayState present but attributeAssertion appears cut. Snippet: 
```
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="groups">... (truncated)
  <saml:Attribute Name="role">dedicated-admin</saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```

devon (eng): truncation could happen if Okta is sending a very large groups list and our proxy header limits hit the assertion body. We recently added nginx header/body buffering changes on auth-proxy.

sam (identity): Also noticed Okta SAML app config had `attributeStatements` ordering changed by their UI — sometimes `role` comes after `groups` which in our old mapper relied on first-seen semantics. That could make us pick the wrong attribute when arrays arrive.

maria (eng-security): So two possibilities: assertion truncation + ordering logic change leading to oscillation between role decisions. We need an immediate mitigation.

neha (oncall): Mitigation idea: temporarily pin role-mapper to v2.12.7 (previous release) and enable strict dedupe in event processor. I can cut the rollback if agreed.

devon (eng): I can cut rollback now. Also will add a quick guard: if a single request_id triggers a role change twice within 60s, drop the second action and log a suspicious-event for triage. Should be safe.

sam (identity): Also push to Okta: reduce groups sent in SAML to only essential groups for role mapping, and enable `Include in Assertion` on the role attribute explicitly. I'll change the app mapping and ask Okta to stop sending the 4000+ group list.

maria (eng-security): Please do both: rollback + Okta change. We also need to confirm audit logs are tamper-evident and encrypted. Who manages the KMS key for audit logs?

devon (eng): audit-logger encrypts log blobs with projects/audit-log-key in KMS. I can confirm key access policy — but note the role-mapper also reads the key for signed event envelopes. If rollback happens, we still need to ensure event dedupe is robust.

neha (oncall): Rolling back now. devon, can you post rollback command?

devon (eng): Running: `./deploy rollback role-mapper v2.12.7 --env=prod --force`

deploy-bot: Initiated rollback of role-mapper to v2.12.7 by @devon. Waiting on canary checks.

maria (eng-security): I'll monitor onboarding channel. sam please coordinate Okta change with identity-admins.

sam (identity): On it — asked Okta admin to update attribute statements and limit groups. ETA 20m.

idaudit-bot: Alert: multiple role-change events for same req_93b1 detected. Ticket created: SEC-7283.

neha (oncall): Canary passed. Rollback complete.

maria (eng-security): After rollback, immediate repro didn't occur for the three affected accounts. Phew.

sam (identity): Okta admin confirmed they set role attribute to 'Include in SAML assertion' and added a regex to strip unnecessary group names.

devon (eng): Next steps I will: 1) add assertion size guard in auth-proxy (increase buffer & log full body for suspicious requests), 2) make role-mapper idempotent by using event-store write-once semantics keyed on request_id, 3) add unit tests for attribute ordering variance.

maria (eng-security): Also: schedule postmortem and add an audit check to ensure no other requests had truncated assertions. Add KMS key rotation note to SEC-7283 — confirm that audit-logger's key policy has only ops+security roles.

neha (oncall): Filing postmortem draft in #postmortems and assigning initial owners: @maria (sec), @devon (eng), @sam (identity).

sam (identity): Quick follow-up — is there a risk of role enumeration via repeated SetRole/RemoveRole logs? We should rotate event correlation IDs if necessary.

maria (eng-security): Good point. We'll treat those request_ids as sensitive and ensure they are redacted in public logs; internal audit keeps them. Add to postmortem.

devon (eng): Will also add a safeguard that role mapping functions never accept attributes longer than 32k bytes and will fail open to the default viewer role if assertion size exceeded, with explicit audit log entry.

maria (eng-security): Thanks everyone. I'll update the incident tracker and close after postmortem draft. :white_check_mark:
